scope: R-008 candidate D: keep the OEM display stack so the vendor driver powers the display, then measure whether it actually initialises
reason: D-130/D-131: the diagnostic simplefb variant deliberately omits CPRDxe/DisplayDxe/UFSDxe, so nothing in the image ever powers the display domain, and every MDP read is an unclocked access. nuwa never hits this because it always ships the vendor DisplayDxe. Candidate D puts the vendor stack back and asks the narrowest question first: does DisplayDxe return success on this device at all?

profiles.gate: DisplayDxe CoreStartImage returned EFI_SUCCESS within a matching GUID

timing_classes.fast_return: DisplayDxe StartImage returned success, gate fires, 2 s delay then PSCI reset; adb expected around 16-18 s
timing_classes.slow_return: DisplayDxe returned an error so the gate does not fire, dispatch continues to the end of CoreDispatcher, the 7 s completion fallback resets; adb expected several seconds later
timing_classes.stall: DisplayDxe or an earlier OEM driver hangs; no return within 75 s

discrimination.fast_return: the vendor display stack runs and reports success on enuma; the display domain is then powered, so later MDP reads become legal and screen text becomes possible
discrimination.slow_return: the vendor stack runs but fails; its own error path is the next thing to read, and reading MDP stays illegal
discrimination.stall: the vendor stack itself hangs on this device; candidate D is out and the choice falls back to B (power the domain from firmware) or C1 (UART)

risk_note: DisplayDxe normally draws through GOP, so the panel may change during this trial; that is expected and is not treated as a probe result. A stall here would need a manual power key recovery like the earlier ones.
hardware_order: immediate identity/backup/recovery gate, one temporary boot
pixel_access: by the vendor driver only, not by this project's code
mmio_writes: by the vendor driver only, not by this project's code
